summary: Add managed streaming subscriptions for Solid client routes: useManagedStream/createManagedStream publish one consistent connection state with cursor replay, bounded jittered reconnect, heartbeat stale detection, host session/CSRF re-auth and telemetry, owner-bound cleanup on route unmount, and RPC cache invalidation hooks; harden stream close during reconnect backoff and single-instance solid-js in client-host tests.
